content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Denver

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma will determine your required experience hours. Granite PM Academy can help you assess whether you qualify before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Denver-based instructors deliver the full PMI-required curriculum across interactive sessions. You'll cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application—earning all contact hours needed to satisfy PMI's prerequisite for application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your boot camp, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI. You'll document your project-management experience and education, then pay PMI's exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce what you've learned. When you're ready, schedule your proctored PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts as you close knowledge gaps.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy offers continuing education courses, webinars, and resources to help you accumulate PDUs and stay current with project-management best practices.
